# Stella · Illustrated IELTS Ecosystem

> Stella is a local-first, illustrated vocabulary and IELTS skills learning web application with 7,298 words, native pronunciations, and FSRS spaced repetition.

## Links

- [Dictionary Atlas](https://stella.zhugez.workers.dev/#/atlas): 7,298 illustrated vocabulary entries with multi-directional language pairs.
- [Practice Studio](https://stella.zhugez.workers.dev/#/practice): Muscle memory and typing practice with real-time feedback.
- [About Stella](https://stella.zhugez.workers.dev/#/about): Open-source project details, credits, and architecture.
